summary: Recent updates to the image decoding capabilities in Firefox focus on improving how the browser handles JPEG XL (JXL) images, a modern image format known for its efficient compression and high-quality visuals. By recognizing common JXL color spaces through Color Image File Interchange (CICP) enums rather than creating an ICC profile (a method used for color management), Firefox enhances its ability to accurately display colors in these images. Additionally, new logging features have been added for the JXL decoder, which will help developers track issues and improve performance. This means users can expect **better color accuracy** and a more reliable experience when viewing JXL images online.
